lastEditorialNotes: Harvey interview represents exactly the kind of technical depth this publication should prioritise - actual architectural thinking rather than feature announcements. Clio's in-house strategy is significant for practice management evolution. Worth monitoring whether other PM platforms follow this direction. The lack of genuinely new legal AI announcements in this cycle suggests the market may be consolidating around established players rather than innovating at the pace seen in 2025.
